said.help/main:
Usage: miyu im <COMMAND>

Commands:
  start                  Start Connect Messaging
  stop                   Stop Connect Messaging
  restart                Restart Connect Messaging
  status                 Show the running state
  web                    Open the management page in a browser
  logs [-f]              Show the run log
  logs watch [<venue>]   Watch what the AI does, live
  venue show <venue>     Show the settings of a venue and their sources
  records import <file>  Import chat records
  whitelist <command>    Manage the private chat whitelist
  access <command>       Manage the access lists

Run 'miyu im <command> --help' for the usage of a command
said.help/start:
Usage: miyu im start

Start Connect Messaging and keep starting it with the core
said.help/stop:
Usage: miyu im stop

Stop Connect Messaging and stop starting it with the core
said.help/restart:
Usage: miyu im restart

Restart Connect Messaging
said.help/status:
Usage: miyu im status

Show the running state and the NapCat connections
said.help/web:
Usage: miyu im web

Open the management page in a browser (the link is valid for 1 minute); starts Connect Messaging first if it is off (as 'start' does)
said.help/logs:
Usage: miyu im logs [-f]
       miyu im logs watch [<venue>]

Show the run log, the standard error first if it has anything

Options:
  -f    keep showing new lines

watch: follow what the AI does in a venue live: messages, decisions, thinking, tool calls, what it sends. Write the venue as qq:<number> (group or private chat); leave it out to watch all
said.help/venue:
Usage: miyu im venue show <venue>

Show the settings of a venue and their sources

Venues:
  <platform>:<bot>:group:<group>   A group
  <platform>:<bot>:private:<user>  A private chat

Example: 'miyu im venue show qq:10001:group:123456'
said.help/records:
Usage: miyu im records import <file>

Import chat records from a JSON Lines file, one message, event or judgment per line (format: design 04 of miyu-im). Records already there are kept and not added again. If any line is wrong, nothing is imported
said.help/whitelist:
Usage: miyu im whitelist [<command>]

Manage the private chat whitelist (same as miyu im access whitelist)

Commands:
  list           List the whitelist (default)
  add <user>     Add a user
  remove <user>  Remove a user
said.help/access:
Usage: miyu im access [<list> [<command>]]

Manage the access lists, or show them all without a list

Lists:
  whitelist      The private chat whitelist
  group          The group list
  skip <group>   People in a group who skip the judge

Commands:
  list           Show the list (default)
  add <id>       Add an entry
  remove <id>    Remove an entry
said.cli/see-help: run 'miyu im --help' to see the commands
said.cli/see-command-help: run 'miyu im {command} --help' to see the usage
said.access/no-group: group {group} is not on the group list
said.access/no-group-hint: add it first with 'miyu im access group add {group}'
said.web/not-ready: Connect Messaging did not come up in time
said.web/open-by-hand: open this address in a browser (valid for 1 minute): {url}
said.notice/page-in-use: management page port {port} is in use, the page is unavailable
said.notice/page-in-use-hint: pick another port with 'miyu config set im.web.port <port>'
said.notice/disconnected: NapCat disconnected, waiting for it to reconnect
said.notice/disconnected-as: NapCat disconnected (bot {bot}), waiting for it to reconnect
said.failure/port-in-use-hint: pick another port with 'miyu config set im.qq.listen <port>' and change the NapCat address to match
said.notice/no-token: no token set, NapCat connections will be refused
said.notice/no-token-hint: open the management page with 'miyu im web' and paste the NapCat token
said.failure/not-spawned: no handshake reply from the core
said.failure/not-spawned-hint: 'miyu-im serve' is started by the core only, use 'miyu im start'
said.status/waiting: Connect Messaging exited, restarting in {seconds} s ({failures} failures in a row)
said.status/stopped: Connect Messaging stopped and will not be restarted: {reason}
said.status/stopped-logs: see the log with 'miyu im logs'
said.status/stopped-restart: run 'miyu im restart' after fixing it
said.status/missing: the core has no miyu-im package
said.status/page: open the management page with 'miyu im web'
said.status/misread: these settings could not be read, using the rule files instead: {keys}
said.reason/config_error: a configuration error or a port in use (exit code 1)
said.reason/cannot_start: the process could not be started, or its directory or standard error file could not be created
said.reason/protocol_mismatch: the manifest protocol version does not match the core
said.failure/factory: cannot start: the factory data has problems (a packaging error):
said.venue/defaults: parameters not listed use the factory defaults.toml
said.venue/problems: problems found while reading (the faulty key, rule or file is not used):
said.records/skipped: skipped {duplicates} already in the records and {conflicts} whose number is taken by a different message
said.problem/not-an-option: {key} is not one of the options: {got}
said.watch/cli-failed: cannot reach the im page server: {why}
said.watch/cli-none: no conversation {venue} seen: nothing has happened since im started
said.watch/cli-both: {id} is both a group and a private chat; write qq:group:{id} or qq:private:{id}
said.watch/cli-watching-all: watching every conversation, Ctrl+C to quit
